description.text: Business administration is an interdisciplinary subject centered on the operation and management of enterprise organizations. It integrates theories from management, economics, sociology, psychology, and data analysis, and studies how to enhance enterprise efficiency, optimize resource allocation, and achieve sustainable development through scientific management methods.Core objective:Cultivate compound talents with strategic thinking, practical management skills and cross-departmental collaboration capabilities, enabling them to work in core positions such as strategic planning, human resource management, marketing and operation management in various enterprises (including multinational companies and small and medium-sized enterprises), government agencies and non-profit organizations.

duration.text: The MBA at Guangdong University Of Foreign Studies is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 15000 USD/per year ￥ 108000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1) Undergraduate diploma and bachelor degree certificate and academic transcripts. (The notarized Chinese or English version must be provided if the originals are in other languages.)2) GMAT, GRE, TOEFL or IETLS and etc. certificate.3) Two recommendation letters. (The title of your referees should be associate professor or above.)4) Passport page and Chinese visa page (*if have).5) 1-inch digital bareheaded colorized photo.6) Passport page and Chinese Visa page (*if have).7) Self-drafted resume (in English).8) Study plan (in English).9) Non-Criminal Records with Chinese language translation and official notarization stamp from Chinese Embassy, or with the APOSTILLE verification. (In 6 months. If you have study or work experience in China, please provide both the record from both your home country and China.)10) Physical examination report.

requirements.text: 1) Bachelor degree or above2) Adaptability to English-medium instruction required
